terms.definition: A tissue that contracts to create movement.
terms.function: Pulls on bones and moves the body.
terms.whereItIs: Throughout the body, in three types.
terms.whyItMatters: Muscles power every move you make.

terms.definition: The striated muscle that moves the body on command.
terms.function: Moves bones when you decide to move.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the muscle you control.

terms.whereItIs: In walls of organs like the stomach.
terms.whyItMatters: It runs digestion and blood flow without thought.

terms.definition: The heart muscle that beats automatically.
terms.whyItMatters: It keeps blood flowing for a lifetime.
